title: Certificate Tape Rewind
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w$ be a Boolean input word, and fix a saved configuration of $M$ on $w$, a certificate word $u$, semantic control states $q$ and $d$, and an input position $i\le |w|$. Suppose that, for every input symbol and every tuple of work-tape symbols, the evaluator's transition from state $q$ moves the certificate head left when its scanned cell is occupied and moves it right into state $d$ when that cell is blank. For every $n\in\mathbb N$ with $n\le |u|$, running the evaluator for $n+1$ steps from its canonical configuration in state $q$, at input position $i$ and with certificate head at $n-1$, yields the canonical configuration in state $d$, at the same input position and with certificate head at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
the stated transition behavior holds for every input and work-tape reading
